audio.description: Active and completed IDs must be positive and less than nextId; identities are correlated with run and the original observation context.

heartbeat.description: An accepted receipt additionally requires receivedContinuousNanos >= issuedContinuousNanos and a latency strictly less than 25000000000 ns. Engine also verifies current epoch, nonce, emission, and sequence high water.

action.description: The writer retains ownership independently until a durable receipt.

trace.description: Integer fields require integer lexical form. A stream has a launch, contiguous positive seq, nondecreasing m, explicit input/actions pairs, and a correlated end. Rotation preserves whole lines. No raw system message or device address is permitted.

selection.description: from is inclusive, to is exclusive; from must precede to. Only selected build records contribute.

logRecord.description: Closed projection of the system ndjson envelope. Future adapters must validate and project known system fields before parsing; projection must never discard a recognized malformed message.

$comment: Cross-field temporal, identity, and phase constraints are also enforced by the pure decoders and Engine. JSON numbers must use integer lexical syntax for integer fields; duplicate keys are invalid at every depth.
